title.zh: Shadowrocket 节点异常排查宝典：连上后无网络、无法访问 App Store 与耗电过快排障
title.en: Shadowrocket Troubleshooting & Battery Optimization: No Internet, App Store Timeouts & Battery Drain

description.zh: 全面解决 iOS 平台 Shadowrocket 运行中的疑难杂症。深度修复开启代理后微信与 App Store 无法加载、节点测速全部超时（Timeout）、手机发热耗电严重及跨 Wi-Fi 断流自愈方案。
description.en: Comprehensive failure diagnosis and battery conservation guide for Shadowrocket on iOS. Fixes zero-throughput bugs, App Store timeouts, battery drain, and cellular-to-Wi-Fi network switching dropouts.
